args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.7-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1.71091

- Reset all settings keeps your saved profiles and puts every font back at once.
- The game's own font sizes really return to normal (the inherited fonts no longer stay enlarged).
- Persian chat keeps the game's look: a chat window takes the Persian font only once Persian shows in it, the typing box keeps the game font, sizes are whole points (no blur).
- Quest objectives with items are in Persian (2,570 quest item names, e.g. Miners' Union Card).
- From your reports: '(Complete)' on finished objectives, the 'Quests: 9/40' line, and the alerts 'You need to be closer...', 'You don't have a pet!', 'Thank you for your report!'.
